DOC8DC0BB5A227FDA3.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DC0BB5A227FDA3.description:
ORA–415 is intended to aid Principal Investigators (PI) in determining whether certain types of projects, such as human in the loop (HITL) studies, quality improvements activities, engineering studies, or use of data/specimens are subject to oversight by the NASA IRB.
Effective 27Mar2025
DOC8DC0BB5A227FDA3.name: ORA - 415 - GUIDANCE: Human Subjects Research Determination

DOC8DC0BB5A227FDA5.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DC0BB5A227FDA5.description:
HRP–405 defines the NASA IRB policy and processes related to determining whether certain types of projects, such as human in the loop (HITL) studies, quality improvements activities, engineering studies, or use of data/specimens are subject to oversight.
Effective 14Aug2023
DOC8DC0BB5A227FDA5.name: ORA - 405 - SOP: Human Subjects Research Determination

DOC8DC0BB5A22800D4.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DC0BB5A22800D4.description:
HRP–420 defines the NASA IRB 
criteria and processes related to 
determining when the NASA IRB will 
use exempt procedures for review of 
research.
Effective 20Aug2025
DOC8DC0BB5A22800D4.name: ORA - 420 - SOP: Exempt Review
DOC8DC0BB5A22800D4.relFilePath: EIRB/sd/resource/doc/DOC8DC0BB5A22800D4/ORA - 420 - NASA IRB Review Level - Exempt Determination v.6.1.pdf

DOC8DC0BB5A22800D8.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DC0BB5A22800D8.description:
ORA–210 describes the NASA IRB Membership, including member selection, length of service, member responsibilities, and member removal.
Effective 27Mar2025
DOC8DC0BB5A22800D8.name: ORA - 210 - SOP: NASA IRB Membership

DOC8DC0BB5A22800DA.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DC0BB5A22800DA.description:
ORA–430 defines the criteria and 
processes related to when the NASA 
IRB may review new applications, 
modifications, and continuing review 
reports by expedited procedures. 
Expedited review allows the NASA 
IRB to review and approve studies 
that meet the criteria within this SOP 
without convening a meeting of the 
full NASA IRB.
Effective 20Aug2025
DOC8DC0BB5A22800DA.name: ORA - 430 - SOP: Expedited Review

DOC8DC0BB5A22800DC.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DC0BB5A22800DC.description:
ORA–440 defines the criteria and processes related to continuing review of human subjects research. Continuing review allows the NASA IRB to conduct thorough and meaningful evaluation of ongoing human subjects research in compliance with federal regulations and NASA IRB policies and procedures.
Effective 13Sep2023
DOC8DC0BB5A22800DC.name: ORA - 440 - SOP: Continuing Review

DOC8DC0BB5A22800DE.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DC0BB5A22800DE.description:
HRP–450 establishes the process for 
closure of NASA IRB approved 
protocols.
Effective 18Aug2025
DOC8DC0BB5A22800DE.name: ORA - 450 - SOP: Study Closure

DOC8DC71D1655D446B.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DC71D1655D446B.description:
ORA–705 provides guidance for researchers and IRB staff to help determine when a clinical trial must be registered on ClinicalTrials.gov and/or when an informed consent form must be posted on ClinicalTrials.gov.
Effective 30Apr2025
DOC8DC71D1655D446B.name: ORA - 705 - Guidance: ClinicalTrials.gov

DOC8DC71D1655D446D.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DC71D1655D446D.description:
ORA–700 provides information for studies meeting the FDAAA, NIH, or Revised Common rule definition of a clinical trial, the ‘designated Responsible Party’ required to register and post results on ClinicalTrials.gov, and/or upload a consent to a public Federal Web site.
Effective 01Apr2023
DOC8DC71D1655D446D.name: ORA - 700 - SOP: ClinicalTrials.gov Policy

DOC8DC71D1655D4624.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DC71D1655D4624.description:
HRP–470 outlines NASA IRB’s authority to suspend or terminate NASA IRB-approved human subjects research that is not being conducted in accordance with NASA IRB’s requirements or that has been associated with a detrimental change in the risk-benefit ratio.
Effective 08Apr2021
DOC8DC71D1655D4624.name: ORA - 470 - SOP: Suspension and Termination of Research
DOC8DC71D1655D4624.relFilePath: EIRB/sd/resource/doc/DOC8DC71D1655D4624/HRP - 470 - SOP - Suspension and Termination of Research_final_8April2021(1).pdf

DOC8DC7AEDA72879FC.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DC7AEDA72879FC.description:
HRP–950 informs researchers, NASA IRB staff, and NASA IRB members when scientific merit review is required prior to NASA IRB review and approval.
Effective 21May2024
DOC8DC7AEDA72879FC.name: ORA - 950 - SOP: Scientific Merit Review

DOC8DC7AEDA7288459.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DC7AEDA7288459.name: eIRB Guide - Submit a New NHSR Study

DOC8DC90EE48B6684A.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DC90EE48B6684A.description:
ORA–990 outlines guidance on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and provides a list of special considerations for human subjects research projects using AI.
Effective 04Feb2025
DOC8DC90EE48B6684A.name: ORA - 990 - GUIDANCE: Artificial Intelligence

DOC8DCB1EF3F3940CC.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DCB1EF3F3940CC.description:
ORA–720 defines the NASA IRB policy and processes with respect to planning for and handling the return of research results to individual study participants. Please note this SOP does not change any other NASA medical policies or procedures for medical treatment or care of crewmembers.
Effective 01May2024
DOC8DCB1EF3F3940CC.name: ORA - 720 - SOP: Return of Research Results

DOC8DCB1EF3F3940CE.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DCB1EF3F3940CE.description:
ORA–710 defines the NASA IRB policy and processes with respect to planning for and handling incidental findings during research studies.
Effective 01May2024
DOC8DCB1EF3F3940CE.name: ORA - 710 - SOP: Incidental Findings

DOC8DCB1EF3F3943F6.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DCB1EF3F3943F6.description:
ORA–435 defines the processes and procedures for reviewing changes previously approved NASA IRB non-exempt protocol and study documents. Changes are also known as amendment and modification, interchangeably.
Effective 09Aug2024
DOC8DCB1EF3F3943F6.name: ORA - 435 - SOP: Changes to Approved Research

DOC8DCB1EF3F39440F.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DCB1EF3F39440F.description:
ORA–810 describes the process to ensure prompt reporting by the NASA IRB to appropriate institutional officials, sponsors, coordinating centers, and the appropriate regulatory heads.
Effective 07Aug2024
DOC8DCB1EF3F39440F.name: ORA - 810 - SOP: Mandated Reporting

DOC8DCB1EF3F394511.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DCB1EF3F394511.description:
ORA–820 outlines the NASA IRB’s authority to suspend or terminate NASA IRB-approved human subjects research that is not being conducted in accordance with the IRB’s requirements or that has been associated with a detrimental change in the risk-benefit ratio.
Effective 07Aug2024
DOC8DCB1EF3F394511.name: ORA - 820 - SOP: Suspension or Termination of IRB Approval

DOC8DCB1EF3F394516.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DCB1EF3F394516.description:
ORA–410 defines the processes and procedures for initial review by the convened NASA IRB.
Effective 07Aug2024
DOC8DCB1EF3F394516.name: ORA - 410 - SOP: Initial Full Board Review

DOC8DCC992F96B106D.author: Jen Ensley Gorshe
DOC8DCC992F96B106D.description:
ORA–800 outlines the program objectives and specific services offered through the ORA Compliance and Quality Improvement Program (OCQI).
Effective 24Jul2024
DOC8DCC992F96B106D.name: ORA - 800 - SOP: ORA Quality Improvement and Outreach Program Overview

DOC8DCCD7904F28AF0.author: Jen Ensley Gorshe
DOC8DCCD7904F28AF0.description:
ORA–102 outlines the processes and responsibilities when the NASA IRB relies on an External IRB (i.e., NASA cedes IRB oversight) when NASA is engaged in human subjects research.
Effective 22May2024
DOC8DCCD7904F28AF0.name: ORA - 102 - SOP: Reliance Acknowledgement - NASA Ceding

DOC8DCCD7904F28AF2.author: Jen Ensley Gorshe
DOC8DCCD7904F28AF2.description:
ORA–101 establishes the process and responsibilities when the NASA IRB serves as the Reviewing IRB (or IRB of Record) in a formal Reliance Acknowledgement (RA).
Effective 26Feb2025
DOC8DCCD7904F28AF2.name: ORA - 101 - SOP: Reliance Acknowledgement - NASA Reviewing IRB

DOC8DCEE81C27FCA5C.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DCEE81C27FCA5C.description:
ORA–801 outlines the purpose of NASA’s ORA Compliance and Quality Improvement (OCQI) Post-Approval Support (PAS) program to support Principal Investigators (PI) and research teams in the conduct of ethical human subjects research throughout the lifecycle of the study.
Effective 24Jul2024
DOC8DCEE81C27FCA5C.name: ORA - 801 - SOP: Post-Approval Support

DOC8DCEE81C27FCCE9.author: Arturo Garza
DOC8DCEE81C27FCCE9.description:
ORA–730 outlines the requirements for recruitment methods and materials, including compensation, for human research participant activities.
